$comment: Release flags per feature (README 'Feature flags'). The firmware flag is a SCREEN decision: a feature = pre-made screens plus the UI only they use (their *_view, f1_*, ...), or a group of unfinished parts / foundations. Components and foundations not listed belong to the library (in docs + firmware): finished parts stay in so custom specs can use them; list one under a feature only when it is that screen's own UI or unfinished. docs: shown on the docs site + workbench nav; status: the label the docs show (done | wip | preview); firmware: compiled into the panel firmware (and listed in the factory deck, Home, Settings > Screens). Build-time only: tools/features.mjs reads this; `node renderer/tools/features.mjs check` (run by build.sh) fails when a shown feature needs a hidden one or a source belongs to no feature. ids: screens = spec ids (specs/<id>.json) or registered screens; components / foundations = registered ids; core = renderer/core files only this feature uses (left out of the firmware with it); cards = Home card types that open this feature's screen; docs_pages = its detail screens (spec role detail: opened from a card or a parent screen, never a deck page) that still get their own docs page (a released screen such as Light; other detail screens open only inside their parent's demo); colour = Colour page sections (colour.json groups / contrast sections) it owns besides its ids; roadmap = roadmap rows (hidden when every feature naming them is hidden).

release.about: Screen channels (RELEASING.md 'Screen channels'). stable = the latest stable release's version. Every feature with firmware or docs true says since: the release its screens first shipped in, or next while no release has them yet; screen_since overrides it for one screen that shipped later. A screen's channel: stable when since <= release.stable, beta when since is a released beta, soon (Coming soon) when since is next or the feature is not on the firmware. tools/features.mjs check fails when one is missing, and compares them with the release tags when the tags are there (`features.mjs since` prints what the tags say). Before a tag: `node renderer/tools/features.mjs since --write V`.

panel_features.about: What every panel has, not a screen you put on it or on a Home deck: the docs list these under On every panel (Screens overview, root README), never among the screens. An entry is one of the panel's own screens (screen: its channel is that screen's) or a setting (setting: an id in tokens/settings.json, with its own since). A screen listed here is kind panel; every other screen is kind screen.

list.label: Set up
list.about: What a new panel shows until it is on Wi-Fi and added to Home Assistant, one step at a time.

list.label: Settings
list.about: Every setting on the panel itself: theme, accent, sounds, screens, idle and updates.

list.label: Screens and Home
list.about: Settings > Screens: every screen of the panel, always on, with where its data comes from; tap one for its source and options.

list.label: Idle clock
list.about: The Clock without its header, shown when no one has touched the panel for a while, or the album art while music plays.

list.label: Home Assistant link
list.about: Settings > Home Assistant: the panel's own link to Home Assistant, its address and token kept on the panel.

list.label: API keys
list.about: Settings > API keys: the keys scripts, automations and agents use to change the panel; you allow each on the glass, and revoke them here.

list.label: Update channels
list.about: Settings > Update channel: Release, every finished version; Beta, test builds of the next version; or Dev (nightly).

list.label: Report a problem
list.about: Settings > Report a problem: the address of the panel's report page, with its logs kept across restarts and an issue filled in.

wip.about: Coming soon from the wip branch: screens being designed that are in no firmware and not on main yet. Their channel is always soon (Coming soon), like a feature off the firmware; the docs show them on /screens/coming-soon/ (the pictures: site/public/coming-soon/<picture>-720.png and -360.webp) and four in the root README's Coming soon strip (tools/readme_assets.mjs --coming-soon). An id here is never a screen of a feature: when one comes to main it moves into features.

list.label: F1 live
list.about: The race as it runs: the order, the gaps and every car on a map of the circuit.
list.note: All 23 circuits of the season are drawn from their real shapes.

pictures.alt: F1 live: the running order beside the circuit map

list.label: Tennis live
list.about: A match point by point: the score, who's serving and where the ball is on the court.
list.note: Each court is drawn in its own surface, Wimbledon's grass among them.

pictures.alt: Tennis live: the score above the court

list.label: Plants
list.about: Which plants need water first, with each one's soil moisture against its own limit.

pictures.alt: Plants: the driest plant and the rest in a list

list.label: Blinds and curtains
list.about: How far a blind or curtain is open, with open, stop and close.

pictures.alt: A blind 60% open with open, stop and close

list.label: Door lock
list.about: Whether the door is locked, who last locked or unlocked it, and a hold to open.
list.note: Opening a door takes a hold, never a single tap.

pictures.alt: Door lock: jammed, with the last 24 hours

list.label: GitHub
list.about: The pull requests waiting on you: reviews, assignments and failing checks.

pictures.alt: GitHub: three pull requests that need you

list.label: Thermostat
list.about: The room's temperature on a dial, the target you set and the heating mode.

list.label: Lightning
list.about: The nearest lightning strike, how many in the last 15 minutes and whether it's coming closer.

list.label: 3D print
list.about: A 3D print's progress, time left and temperatures, with the model being printed.
list.note: Getting the 3D model of the print is still being worked out.

library.label: Component library
library.about: Every component and foundation not listed under a feature below: the parts people (and custom specs) build screens with, so a finished one ships even when no shipped screen uses it.

later.about: Features held on the wip branch until they are finished (spec of contract parts, feed on the skeleton, gate green); the docs roadmap shows their rows as in progress.

features.label: Living room
features.about: One room's lights to switch and dim: out of 1.0 (it repeats the Light screen; a room view may come back later).
